title: Translunar
goal: Fly the crew safely to lunar orbit.

translunar.orbit.title: LUNAR ORBIT
translunar.orbit.text: The engine fires behind the Moon and gravity gently catches the ship. The crew is in a perfect lunar orbit.

translunar.orbitRough.title: ORBIT... ROUGHLY
translunar.orbitRough.text: The burn was a little off, but the ship is circling the Moon. Fuel is tight for the landing.

translunar.flyby.title: MISSED THE MOON
translunar.flyby.text: The burn failed and the ship swung around the Moon and headed back toward Earth.
translunar.flyby.lesson: The orbit insertion burn happens just once. Correct your course early so the final burn has the best chance.

translunar.radiation.title: RADIATION SICKNESS
translunar.radiation.text: The crew took too much radiation and mission control ordered the ship home.
translunar.radiation.lesson: During a solar flare, shelter behind thick walls or water tanks. Then rest if you feel unwell.

translunar.hullBreach.title: HULL SEAM FAILED
translunar.hullBreach.text: The damaged hull seam split under engine thrust and the cabin lost air. The crew had to abort.
translunar.hullBreach.lesson: Damage from launch gets worse under stress. Inspect and repair it before you fire the big engine.
